pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with soft-edged pixel gradients. Patches on the mid-flank are medium-sized and irregular, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries toward the neck and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial, with relatively thin and uniform pathway thickness across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark brown mane is visible along the dorsal neck, exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive grey-blue hyper-pigmentation and textural disruption covering the lower flank and ventral region, significantly obscuring the underlying pelage pattern.
